decisions.reason: Escalation of commitment is high because the 518 FLEX has a dedicated website presence and accumulated positive reputation, making a drop unlikely.
The AK series has received public trade-fair promotion and EU Stage V updates, representing sunk investments and visible commitment that favor keeping it.
Although less quoted than others, the mobile grinder line still has dedicated models and website presence, so management is likely to persist rather than write off that investment.
The CERON generation is publicly framed as standard-setting and already in use, so escalation pressures strongly support keeping it.
